_about: Agentic Delivery Kit (ADK) — project-specific settings. Everything project-specific lives HERE; the scripts in ops/ are generic and should not need editing. Fill in every <<FILL_IN: ...>> value below during bootstrap (see ../CLAUDE.md.template's bootstrap question set), then delete this _about key.
_app_comment: The 'app' block assumes a single-entry-file architecture with a service worker (Clarvoyance's own shape). If this project is a different shape (a CLI tool, an API, a multi-file app), delete this whole 'app' block and adapt verify.js's steps 1-2 to whatever 'the thing a user sees' actually is for this project, or drop them and rely on step 3 (the real test suite) alone.

app.liveEntry: <<FILL_IN: the file users actually load, e.g. index.html>>
app.serviceWorker: <<FILL_IN: e.g. sw.js -- omit this whole key if there is no service worker>>
app.versionFilePattern: <<FILL_IN: candidate file naming pattern, e.g. myapp_v{N}.html>>
app.versionLabelRegex: <<FILL_IN: a JS regex STRING with exactly one capture group that finds the version label text inside liveEntry -- copy Clarvoyance's own ops/adk.config.json for a worked example>>
app.swCacheRegex: <<FILL_IN: a JS regex STRING with exactly one capture group that finds the cache-name constant inside serviceWorker>>
inlineScriptFiles: <<FILL_IN: liveEntry again, if it has inline script blocks worth a syntax check -- else make this an empty array>>

promote.coAuthor: <<FILL_IN: your assistant's required attribution line for commits, if your host has one -- else delete this key and the matching join in promote.js>>

protectedPaths: <<FILL_IN: files a promote is allowed to touch, e.g. index.html, sw.js>>
hostingNote: <<FILL_IN: e.g. GitHub Pages serves the repo root; CDN caches ~10 min after a push -- or delete this key if not relevant>>
